blocking_findings.title: 封存静态资源验证后未以原exact refs持锁，dispatcher/toolchain可在窗口内换成新字节
blocking_findings.evidence: sealed_static_refs validates the eight sealed resource refs but returns only the input-vector file ref. execute then repins dispatcher/toolchain for expected_dispatch and final held refs. The independent source-AST sequence confirms sealed A can pass, followed by a simulated dispatcher change to B, after which both receipt expectation and final held refs contain B and no A resource ref. Holding the vector metadata alone does not hold its members.
blocking_findings.fix: Return the exact eight static resource refs with the vector ref, include all eight in final SourceReadGuard input, and derive expected_dispatch from those accepted refs. Keep conflict detection so any later dynamic pin differing from A fails before launch. Alternatively acquire and validate exact sealed refs before subsequent pin/use. No Main/Canon/Native change required.
blocking_findings.scope: Source logic only; no real file was changed and no dispatcher was executed.
